item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-06-30
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天 Nervos Talk 上 Spark 生态资助项目继续密集推进，多位申请人根据社区反馈修改提案格式和技术细节 [S01, S03, S04]。同时，ViaBTC 矿池宣布将于 7 月 19 日关停 CKB 矿池，引发社区对算力迁移的讨论 [S05, S06]。此外，CellScript 发布 0.16 到 0.20 的重要版本更新，从单纯编译器升级为完整构建工具链 [S09]。 ## 重点话题 **Spark 提案进入密集打磨期**：Carl 的 DID Quickstart Kit 提案经 NightLantern 和 xingtianchunyan 两轮反馈后，已更新标题格式、拆分里程碑为每周检查点，并补充团队背景 [S02, S03, S04]；CellScript AMM Transaction Builder 和 DOB Pattern Studio 等项目也收到 xingtianchunyan 的格式与内容预审意见 [S15, S17]。 **ViaBTC 确认退出 CKB 矿池业务**：社区成员 knmo 转发公告并质疑时机选择，matt_ckb 确认经后续沟通 ViaBTC 维持原决定，用户需在 7 月 19 日 24:00 前处理剩余资产 [S05, S06]。 **CellScript 工具链重大升级**：ArthurZhang 发布 0.16→0.20 版本，新增源码包管理、lockfile、部署身份、生成式构建器、浏览器编译及更严格的 CKB 证据校验，标志着从"编译器"向"完整构建路径"转型 [S09]。...

item.title: ViaBTC | Mining Pool - handle any remaining assets before 24:00 on July 19, 2026 (2 posts)
item.description: ViaBTC | Mining Pool will discontinue the CKB pool Handle any remaining assets before 24:00 on July 19, 2026 viabtc Discontinuation Personally, I wonder whether this is really the right time for the pool operator! While they state that the decision to shut down was made after careful consideration, I doubt that the current global decline in total hashrate was taken into account. The relative proportion of miners working on ViaBTC is likely to be significantly higher at this time than it was in the past, when the hashrate was five to six times higher than it is today. Was consideration given to informing the operators of this? Yes, after follow up communication ViaBTC stuck by their decision.

item.title: USDI on CKB will be discontinued. Any alternative for stablecoin? (1 posts)
item.description: Thinker: We need to ask ourselves why we haven’t retained these projects I would argue from my vantage point that it is practical realities of early stage innovation. Ckb.pw, .bit, UTXO Stack.. they were all sold on the vision but failed to turn the innovative technology into commercial success. It takes some false starts, communication can help but it will not change the challenge. We face a two sided market (cold start) problem, as others have said in this thread, the real question is “how do we increase on-chain activity?”

item.title: CellScript - A DSL for Cell-Based Contracts (1 posts)
item.description: CellScript 0.16 → 0.20 Release Notes CellScript 0.16 to 0.20 is the move from a compiler that emits an artifact and metadata into a fuller build path: source packages, lockfiles, deployment identity, generated builders, browser compilation, and stricter CKB evidence. CellScript now gives downstream tools a clearer answer to “what source was built, what artifact came out, what deployment does it match, and what transaction-builder assumptions still need real CKB evidence?” Why This Is One Note The 0.17, 0.18, and 0.19 work was important, but not cleanly user-facing on its own. item.title: MLAT Airspace Console: CKB-Based Receiver Registry for Aviation Data Infrastructure (1 posts)
item.description: I’ve been building MLAT Airspace Console, a multilateration-focused aviation data platform that uses CKB as a receiver registry/identity layer while keeping signal ingestion, multilateration processing, storage, and delivery off-chain. What I’m building The goal is to support a distributed receiver network where: receiver identity and metadata can be discovered through CKB observations can be processed into aircraft positions downstream users can consume those outputs through an API and dashboard The role of CKB here is not to store aircraft telemetry directly. item.title: CKBA Membership Process (1 posts)
item.description: CKBA Contributing Member — Cycle 1 Outcome Cycle 1 of the CKBA Contributing Member intake is now complete. item.title: Design notes: verifying CKB state inside other chains (EVM-first, built on RFC 44/45) (1 posts)
item.description: @T_Silva thanks again, this was easily the most useful review the design has had. Quick status and then a proposal to actually take you up on comparing notes. The fix is in. I wrote the two-sided bound into the design as its own soundness section and credited you. verify_tx_inclusion now enforces min_confirmations ≤ tip_height − block_height ≤ W, with W capped at the store’s root-retention window.
